population: Constructed development cases from accepted PR41/43/44/42, including two structural signed families, 1/4/16 cold series and retained losing/negative/empty/unsupported/budget cases. Exact fixtures and independent requests are registered before any comparison. No new source rule, external corpus or holdout.
registration: Freeze protocol and case/source/goal/limit/outcome hashes in a commit before comparison; publish the registration branch before measurement when connection allows. Record every attempt and correction, without replacing failed run directories.

routes.retained: unchanged PR38/39 signed v6 covered control; stronger source-interface guarantee, only unguarded all-positive-width singleton requests
routes.direct41: unchanged PR41 native preparation plus ordinary congruence closure
routes.query41: same PR41 native preparation plus Paper II query backend
routes.planner43: unchanged PR43 adaptive native policy and Paper II backend
routes.eager43: unchanged PR43 eager policy with the same permitted native rules and Paper II backend
routes.sdk_default: PR45 no_lemmas: checked native and exact-result caches, no forcing, no derived-lemma promotion
routes.sdk_reuse: PR45 reuse: same signed policy and Paper II backend with eligible checked lemma
routes.sdk_direct: PR45 direct_cache: same lemma policy and ordinary caches, ordinary unfiltered CC at full horizon; bounded diagnostic fallback remains explicit
routes.phase_forcing: PR45 phase adapter over PR42 source seeds and pure-row saturation
routes.phase_no_saturation: same seeds and native tables, domain restricted to generated seeds; unresolved is not a source refutation
routes.phase_direct_seeds: same physical branches and seed facts, direct range/Boolean derivation closes the original obligation without forcing
routes.phase_direct_cell: physical-branch membership directly, with no seed/table preparation

attribution.source_vs_retained: bundled policy/rule/interface change, not an isolated I or II effect; retained proves a stronger interface
attribution.II: query41 versus direct41 on exactly equal native attempts and ground request; sdk_reuse versus sdk_direct on equal source/native/lemma policy, accounting for horizon differences
attribution.observation_selection: planner43 versus eager43; reduction in requested facts is demand selection, not by itself a theorem-II saturation speedup
attribution.reuse: sdk_reuse versus sdk_default: same backend, native and exact-result caches; singleton promotion charged; compare sdk_direct to show ordinary control can also reuse
attribution.I: separate phase table; demonstrate requested D minus S and no direct target queries, then compare the same seeds and physical branch work against direct controls
attribution.signed_without_forcing: identical to each signed route: I is already disabled by A1; do not count a duplicate no-op arm as evidence
attribution.simple_rules: equality-mask and parity identities available to the simple control; their benefit is attributed to native semantic rules, not exclusively to I/II

measurement.amendment_to_PR39: Three rather than five fresh diagnostic repetitions over the expanded registered matrix; no uninstrumented speedup or statistical population inference. All trials retained; no best-run selection.
measurement.order: fixed case order; audit arms in registered order; trial r rotates arms by (case_index+r) modulo arm_count and reverses odd r; serial, no parallel measurements
measurement.memory: one separate fresh audit child per arm, tracemalloc peak since before backend import, including Python instrumentation and diagnostics; not RSS
measurement.timing: three fresh build children with existing backend instrumentation but without PR46 tracing or tracemalloc; wall API and whole child process reported. Canonical proof/result identity must match the audit proof. No removal of accepted guards or budget enforcement for timing.
measurement.phases: retain every named backend phase, failed attempt and fallback. Build includes all built-in checks and PR45 extraction/packing. Separately time fresh cold checking and source-free apply; phase names that combine search/check are labelled mixed rather than decomposed artificially.
measurement.check_trials: one fresh cold checker per audit and timing output; timing outputs bind identical canonical proof/result bytes to the independently replayed audit packet; no search imports
measurement.application_scope: SDK only, on registered inputs and only certified summaries. Repeat full input sequence, validate exact outputs. Native/retained proof routes have no SDK runtime and get not_applicable, never zero cost.
measurement.scenario: build plus fresh cold check plus 64 registered input sequences where applicable; report process overhead separately. Other proof routes are compared on proof-only costs, not on missing application as zero.
measurement.aggregation: all three samples, median/min/max; no universal break-even interpolation; publish first measured non-losing prefix per family, width, route and metric, including singleton losses
measurement.proof_bytes: canonical uncompressed complete standalone packet; source/request bytes and diagnostic bytes separate; old stronger source-interface packet not a matched-size guarantee
measurement.common_trace: separate actual-call audit for every route, outside existing exclusive profilers using call/return tracing; all research calls and declared structural hooks including built-in checks/export. Telemetry is not a proof of execution. Failed attempts remain charged.

failure_policy: Every scheduled arm/trial stays in the denominator. Unsupported contract is listed before execution and is distinct from source unsupported. Crashes/timeouts/identity drift fail the engineering gate; an economic hypothesis may fail without a code failure. No retries inside a run. Fresh normal and optimized replay check every available certificate and historical obligation even if another arm failed.
decision: Report mechanism, structural-work, total-cost and product gates separately. Require two distinct source families for structural savings. A gain over retained alone does not establish competitive advantage. Keep I/reuse opt-in unless matched full-cost comparisons support a narrower recommendation. F1 remains an explicit uncompleted block-A gate; PR46 adds no Lean theorem. Next choose one bounded source-reasoning/IR pilot plus F1, with an external corpus registered only after freezing that engine.
preservation: Every PR45 file stays byte/mode identical except current-research.yml and additive regression SUITES.json. Add new PR46 report/navigation rather than rewrite accepted roadmaps, historical claims, SDK defaults, proofs, installed qkf or old gates.
